seoTitle: Apache Virtual Host Generator (HTTPS, Redirect, Proxy)
metaDescription: Generate Apache VirtualHost configuration for a site: HTTP to HTTPS redirect, TLS paths, document root or reverse proxy, security headers and gzip.
intro: Get a secure starting vhost for Apache 2.4 with the modules you need listed.
why:
Enter the server name, aliases, whether to serve static files or proxy to an app, certificate paths and the document root or proxy target. The output has a port 80 host that redirects to HTTPS, a port 443 host with TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only, HSTS and other security headers, deflate compression and per-site logs. For proxies it sets X-Forwarded-Proto and ProxyPreserveHost.

Enable the listed modules (ssl, rewrite, headers, deflate, proxy, proxy_http) and run apachectl configtest before reloading. Adjust cipher policy and HSTS for your environment.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Enter the domain and choose static or proxy.
Set the certificate and key paths.
Save to sites-available and enable with a2ensite.

faq.a: It tells browsers to use HTTPS for the domain; enable it only when HTTPS works everywhere.

faq.q: Where do Let's Encrypt certificates live?

faq.a: No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
